description: An unsigned transaction for the owner to take what waits at its receiving address out to its own wallet: USDG as USDG before it is swept (token USDG, the default), or ETH or another ERC-20 token sent there by mistake (token ETH, or the token's address). amount is a decimal string, or "all" (the default) for whatever is there when it lands. USDG already swept is the wallet's bUSDG: redeem it from the vault with withdraw. Simulated from the wallet; nothing is sent.

amount.description: How much, as a decimal string, or "all" (default)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: payto_withdraw
title: Prepare: take USDG (or a stray token) out of a receiving address
